prereq_5_fixed_cap_before_games.rationale_without_game_tuning: Per TM_OPEN_ENGINE_LITERATURE_REVIEW_2811.md:67-68 and OPUS-2811-ANSWER-TO-TM-LITERATURE-1625, TmSoftCapPercent=200 scales soft_deadline (= soft_basis * factor), clamped to <= hard_limit_ms_ (5.0x soft_basis, 1585ms at 6+0.06 where soft_basis=317ms) at depth>=6. Scaling soft_deadline rather than soft_basis ensures dynamic unstable/falling-eval/fail-low searches (e.g., factor=1.82x..2.366x) keep 2.0x headroom above soft_deadline instead of collapsing to 0ms slack, so normal 1.0x-1.9x iterations finish cleanly while extreme 5x-15x PV-flip blowups are capped at 2.0x soft_deadline. Wave 15 pre-literature drafts (135/150 scaling soft_basis) are superseded history; constant 200 is fixed strictly before any test game.

risk_disclosure.summary: Stockfish (def601cc, src/search.cpp:2155) deliberately avoids mid-iteration soft aborts below tm.maximum() because cutting a running iteration at 2.0x can discard partial search work and lose a fail-low that was being resolved; instead Stockfish refuses to increase effective depth past 0.50 * totalTime (analogous to Test A / TmFinishIteration). Therefore this Test B remains a declared HYPOTHESIS run strictly after Test A (TmFinishIteration=true vs false).
